evidence:
Source review supports distinct product authorship for this row. Workbook Quality Checks!C54:D54 and Internal Quality Checks row 54 require a product-authored task that fits the suite and is not a nouns-swapped sibling. The frozen skill procedure at references/quality-checks.md:212-214 calls for comparing names and concepts. NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:195-205 permits infrastructure reuse but requires distinct domain behavior; TASK_AUTHORING_WORKFLOW.md:42-58 asks for cohesive business consequences. The frozen template instruction is only a CHANGE_ME stub, whereas task/instruction.md:1-7 describes a concrete Finance problem: moving existing hires between fully committed requisitions, reviewing saved old/new figures, refusing intervening economic history and recovering original receipts after later revisions/rescissions. task/task.toml:6,11,14-15 consistently identifies compensation operations and recruiting-hiring-operations. Local sibling metadata places it within the suite's range of business operations products; no separate external domain-plan or acceptance claim is inferred.

The rules and scored observations change with this domain. task/environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:111-139 separates intrinsic equity value, annualized equity, committed run-rate and signing-bonus-weighted approval basis; sections5-6 preserve original hire/grant anchors while applying distinct signing and equity vesting; section11 nets source releases against destination commitments for a complete set. task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:96-131,582-590,636-644,933-938,1050-1055,1068-1073,1140-1156 actually test financial distinctions, complete-set netting, history-sensitive stale previews, order-insensitive operation identity and original-receipt replay. The implementation is likewise specific: solution/app/src/rules.js:62-70,105-150 derives those compensation and vesting figures; solution/app/src/change-sets.js:13-16,38-64,93-140 captures movement-history versions, nets all touched requisitions, writes successor compensation records atomically and returns stored receipts before later-state validation. Task-relative citations in this paragraph refer to .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r3/task.

The closest sibling by subject is Pellmoor, but projects/pellmoor-job-pipeline/environment/instructions/hiring-rules.md:3-24,27-67,69-122 concerns stage progression, current panel assessment versions, vacancy opening reservations and history-derived funnels. Its batches create offers for interview applicants in one vacancy and preserve array order as intent (107-113); HireOps changes already COMMITTED hires across requisitions and deliberately makes member order irrelevant (hireops_rules.md:422-478, especially433). The closest financial sibling, ExpenseFlow, shares legitimate infrastructure, roles, integer arithmetic and append-only accounting, but projects/expenseflow-business-admin/environment/assets/artifacts/expenseflow_rules.md:147-253,299-397 derives foreign-line reimbursements through FX, policy caps, post-cap tax, residual-plug cost-center allocation and rejected-receipt recovery. Those cannot be renamed into HireOps equity grants, referral clocks, original-hire vesting and netted transfers. Pellmoor hiring-rules SHA256 a49c5dae48db3b4b33f5f317c140ff2c53785be9f8090472fcea4242cf46f5b1; ExpenseFlow rules SHA256 cbd903b81e16a006241c60e62d0d5a47b306dc5982e13404b9187973dfe6afea bind these nonfrozen comparison sources.

Adversarial source assessment: a generic approval/ledger desk with recruiting labels could pass ordinary CRUD/auth observations yet use gross equity value or sequential transfer budgets. The concrete intrinsic and fully-funded-cycle bars at functional/judge.toml:101,938 require different results, so such a clone cannot satisfy the domain bars merely through renamed nouns. A direct Pellmoor clone that treats reordered members as conflicting intent also fails HireOps' reordered-intent observation at1073. Conversely, a conforming app using generated identifiers, different routes and screen names, no imported operational history, and a durable version counter rather than the golden's maximum movement ID remains permitted by instruction.md:5-11, hireops_rules.md:53-55,203-204,435,456 and functional/prompt.md's setup/discovery rules. This is a bounded source comparison, not an executed alternative-app score.
